item.title: My Face on the Astronaut

turns.text: That's me in the park photo. Put my face on the astronaut in the poster, please. Keep the suit, stars and retro look, and don't add any text.

item.tests: Tests recognizable source identity, natural face blending and preservation of the supplied poster.

answer_sheet.Target: The astronaut's visible face in poster-astronaut.jpg.
answer_sheet.Style and preservation: Keep the original retro poster style, suit, helmet and star background.
answer_sheet.Size and platform: Keep the vertical 9:16 poster shape; free-tier size is fine.

must_haves: The astronaut's face is recognizably the woman from portrait-woman.jpg.
The replacement face fits inside the open helmet without conspicuous seams or doubled features.
The original white suit, helmet and star background remain intact.
The result retains the retro poster look and vertical composition.
